alexcrichton opened PR #15223 from alexcrichton:check-engines to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit adds a few cross-engine checks in component::Linker and then additionally ensures there's documentation in component::types about what happens on cross-engine usage. Cross-engine usage was already detected during instantiation and this is mostly just moving the error to happening closer to the point of origin of the mistake.
